Competitor outliers (Oct 2026, 339 Hindi niche videos): Indian temple and goddess mysteries are the biggest winners (Chintpurni 227x, Ambaji 48x, Kalighat 33x, Pavagadh 30x, Tarapith 20x their channel median). Prefer famous temples with a legend or unexplained element, told respectfully.
Ramayana/Mahabharata place-and-proof videos reach 18-26x (2-2.8M views): Ram Setu, Dwarka, Lanka-type topics. Present what archaeology says vs what tradition believes; never mock.
'Wonders that even scientists can't explain' compilations reach 39-89x: strange rock formations, ancient engineering, unexplained places.

Winning title formulas: '<place> का रहस्य', 'चौंका देने वाला रहस्य!', 'सच जानकर हैरान रह जाओगे', 'यह सच आप नहीं जानते', numbered lists ('7 सबसे रहस्यमयी...', '15 जिंदा सबूत'). One emoji like 😱 is common.
Winning long videos run ~22 minutes (median of outliers) vs 19 for the rest: longer, well-paced stories earn more watch time.
European/Western history and Western true-crime topics did not appear among Hindi niche outliers: keep them to at most 1 in 4 topics.
